newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Jan-Aug tea crop up 3.5 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Jan-Aug tea crop up 3.5 pct on year.

text.p: Sri Lanka's black tea output rose to 169.6 million kg in the first eight months of this year from 163.8 million in the same 1995 period, the Tea Board said on Friday.
Output for August increased to 21.15 million kg from 18.59 million a year earlier, a board statement said.
Production of high grown teas dropped to 48.91 million kg during the January-August period from 51.10 million a year ago.
Low growns, which are popular with Russian and Middle East buyers, rose to 89.06 million kg during this period from 78.13 million a year ago, the board said.
